item.title: Book Reviews
item.content:encoded:
JIBS book reviews consider both recent scholarship and enduring classics that are relevant to the JIBS readership and the multidisciplinary scope of the journal. The purpose of book reviews is to make these publications accessible, reflect on their key themes, evaluate their contribution to the field, and set out the future agenda that they may inspire.
